page_title: ATA 1-2 NAP | Atalanta v Napoli 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+1' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) plays a through ball but overhits it.
83' Substitution. Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) replaces Ademola Lookman.
83' Here is a change. Charles De Ketelaere is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
79' 1 - 2 Goal! Victor Osimhen produces a great pass that finds Eljif Elmas (Napoli) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
79' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jens Cajuste (Napoli) will replace Piotr Zielinski.
78' Walter Mazzarri has decided to substitute Natan and he is replaced by Leo Ostigard (Napoli).
76' The substitution is prepared. Giovanni Bonfanti (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sead Kolasinac.
76' The resulting corner from Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) comes to nothing.
74' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Napoli.
72' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
71' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
71' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
68' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) has a goal ruled out for offside!
64' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Victor Osimhen (Napoli) comes onto the pitch so that Giacomo Raspadori can be given a rest.
63' Walter Mazzarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eljif Elmas (Napoli) replacing Matteo Politano.
61' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
60' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
55' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

53' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Hans Hateboer and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
51' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
50' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Pierluigi Gollini comes off his line to intercept.
48' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Gian Piero Gasperini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mitchel Bakker. He is replaced by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' A loose ball is pounced on by Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi is alert and makes a comfortable save.
45+2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

45+1' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Pierluigi Gollini into a superb diving save to keep it out. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

44' 0 - 1 Giovanni Di Lorenzo produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 0:1.
39' Juan Jesus comes onto the pitch because Mathias Olivera (Napoli) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
39' The game is interrupted now, Mathias Olivera (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Napoli players look gutted.
36' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Napoli players aren’t happy.
34' Goal! Giacomo Raspadori picks out Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the right side of the goal with a header from close range. 0:0.
33' Davide Zappacosta comes off the pitch to be replaced by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
33' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
32' Referee Maurizio Mariani has finally had enough of Walter Mazzarri and brandishes a yellow card at him!
31' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
30' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
26' Matteo Politano (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' A long-range free kick is awarded to Napoli.
21' Booking. Natan (Napoli) receives a caution from the referee.
19' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
18' The ball is cleared after Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul after Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) hacks down one of his opponents.
11' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' The corner by Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
6' Napoli win a corner.
6' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.

Napoli will kick the game off.
